config.VENUE_ADDRESS: 12 Marina View, Asia Square Tower 2, Singapore 018961
config.VENUE_ARRIVAL_NOTE: Valet parking is available at the main entrance.
config.TRAVEL_MRT_DIRECTIONS: Take the Downtown Line to Downtown MRT (DT17). Use Exit A and walk approximately 5 minutes via Marina View.
config.TRAVEL_BUS_DIRECTIONS: Alight at Bus Stop 03519 and walk 3 minutes to The Westin.
config.TRAVEL_PARKING: Self-parking is available at Asia Square Tower 2 basement from $1.10 per 10-minute block ($6.60/hr) on weekdays.
config.TRAVEL_DROPOFF: Drop-off at the main hotel entrance on Marina View. Taxis and private hire vehicles may stop here.
config.TRAVEL_HOTEL_DIRECTIONS: The celebration will be held in the Grand Ballroom on Level 3. From the hotel lobby, take the lifts to Level 3.
config.TRAVEL_ACCESSIBILITY: Wheelchair accessible entrances are available on Level 1. Please contact our concierge team at least 48 hours in advance to arrange assistance.

faqs.question: Am I invited to both the dinner and the Nuptial Mass?
faqs.answer: Our dinner reception on Friday, 23 October will be an intimate celebration with limited seating, so attendance is by invitation only. We would be truly honoured to have you join us for our Nuptial Mass on Saturday, 24 October at Church of the Holy Family, as we celebrate our marriage before God, family, and friends.

faqs.question: Can I bring a plus-one?
faqs.answer: As we have made dinner arrangements based on the guests named in each invitation, we kindly ask that only those listed attend the dinner reception. If you would like to bring a plus-one for dinner, please let us know and we will do our best to accommodate where possible.

faqs.question: Are children invited?
faqs.answer: We love your little ones. Please refer to your invitation for the guests included in your party. If you need any clarification, please feel free to reach out to us.

faqs.question: Where can I park?
faqs.answer: Self-parking is available at Asia Square Tower 2 basement. There is parking available on-site at the Church of the Holy Family, but parking lots may be limited. We recommend arriving early or using ride-hailing services where convenient.

faqs.question: What should I wear?
faqs.answer: For the dinner reception, semi-casual, formal, or semi-formal attire is warmly welcome. For the Nuptial Mass, we kindly ask guests to dress modestly and respectfully for the church setting.

faqs.question: Will there be assigned seating at the dinner reception?
faqs.answer: Yes, seating arrangements will be prepared for the evening. Please refer to the seating chart or approach our welcome team, who will be happy to assist you.

faqs.question: Is there wheelchair access?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both the ballroom and church have lifts which are available on Level 1.

faqs.question: What time will the dinner reception end?
faqs.answer: The dinner reception is expected to conclude around 10:00 PM.

faqs.question: What time should I arrive for the Nuptial Mass on Saturday, 24 October?
faqs.answer: Mass begins at 10:30 AM at Church of the Holy Family. We kindly recommend arriving by 10:00 AM so you have time to settle in before the ceremony begins.

faqs.question: Do I need to be Catholic to attend the Mass?
faqs.answer: Not at all. Guests of all faiths are very welcome. You may simply remain seated or follow along respectfully during the service.

faqs.question: May non-Catholic guests receive Holy Communion?
faqs.answer: Holy Communion is reserved for practising Catholics. Guests who are not receiving Communion are welcome to remain seated during this part of the Mass.

faqs.question: Can I take photos during the church ceremony?
faqs.answer: We kindly ask guests to be present and mindful during Mass, and to avoid blocking the aisle or photographer. There will be time for greetings and photographs after the ceremony.

faqs.question: Will there be refreshments after Mass?
faqs.answer: Light refreshments will be served after the ceremony, and we would love for you to stay a while and share in the joy of the morning with us.

faqs.question: Who can I contact on the day itself?
faqs.answer: Please reach out to a member of our wedding party or welcome team for assistance on the day, as we may be occupied with the celebration.

homepage_sections.heading: We cannot wait to celebrate with you.
